summary.plain: A multi-armed particle detector at Brookhaven's RHIC collider that tracked and identified particles from nuclear collisions between 2000 and 2016.
summary.technical: PHENIX: a multi-arm heavy-ion spectrometer at RHIC IP8 combining central-arm and muon-arm subdetectors, operational 2000-06-15 to 2016.

technology.note: General description; detailed subsystem specs were not independently verified (see the experiment:phenix notes).
technology.value: Multi-arm spectrometer combining central-arm tracking/calorimetry at midrapidity with forward/backward muon-arm spectrometers, each with its own magnet
